cohort: 153 pregnant women who experienced trauma and were referred to the Prof. Dr. Cemil Tascıoglu City Hospital's emergency services between January 1, 2017, and December 31, 2022
finding: Compared to the general population, traumatized pregnant women experienced increased rates of PPROM, PROM, fetal death, fetal distress, Cesarean delivery, placental abruption, and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in traumatized pregnant women.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at time of trauma was 21.59±9.89 weeks
